The [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Iskalloni]] [[Species/Legends|species]] utilized a special '''mutagen''' to help their bodies adapt to [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic implants]]. They also injected their [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] with the mutagen, converting them into Iskalloni.
